Hey #40c3, I'm looking forward to presenting "From Finding Bugs to Shipping Fixes: Scaling Firefox Security in the Age of LLMs" next month. The talk will focus on the technical implementation, some of the high-severity bugs we found, and the organizational challenges that come with a sudden rise in identified vulnerabilities.

In preparation of my talk, what are your other questions about bug finding at scale?

will you be at #40c3? do you speak more than one language? live interpretation might be for you!
